from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import NotFoundError, ValidationFailedError
from app.db.models.approval import Approval
from app.db.models.chat import Run
from app.db.models.conversation import Conversation, Message
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.conversations.schemas import (
    CitationOut,
    ConversationCreateRequest,
    ConversationDetailOut,
    ConversationOut,
    ConversationPage,
    ConversationUpdateRequest,
    LastRunOut,
    MessageArtifactOut,
    MessageAttachmentOut,
    MessageCapabilitiesOut,
    MessageErrorOut,
    MessageOut,
    MessagePage,
    UsageOut,
)

_DELETED = "deleted"


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _escape_like(value: str) -> str:
    return value.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("%", "\\%").replace("_", "\\_")


def _pending_approval_subquery():
    now = _now()
    return (
        select(func.count(Approval.id))
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
        .where(
            Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > now),
        )
        .correlate(Conversation)
        .scalar_subquery()
    )


def _conversation_out(row: Any) -> ConversationOut:
    conversation: Conversation = row[0]
    pending = int(row[1] or 0)
    return ConversationOut(
        id=conversation.id,
        title=conversation.title,
        status="archived" if conversation.status == "archived" else "active",
        message_count=conversation.message_count,
        last_message_preview=conversation.last_message_preview,
        last_message_at=conversation.last_message_at,
        pending_approval_count=pending,
        created_at=conversation.created_at,
        updated_at=conversation.updated_at,
    )


def _apply_cursor(stmt, cursor: dict[str, Any]):
    if not cursor:
        return stmt
    raw_time = cursor.get("t")
    raw_id = cursor.get("id")
    try:
        last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
        last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
    if last_id is None:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
    if last_time is None:
        return stmt.where(
            Conversation.last_message_at.is_(None),
            Conversation.id < last_id,
        )
    return stmt.where(
        or_(
            Conversation.last_message_at < last_time,
            and_(Conversation.last_message_at == last_time, Conversation.id < last_id),
        )
    )


async def list_conversations(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    q: str | None,
    status: str,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> ConversationPage:
    pending = _pending_approval_subquery()
    base = select(Conversation, pending.label("pending_count")).where(
        Conversation.user_id == user.id,
        Conversation.status != _DELETED,
    )
    if q:
        base = base.where(Conversation.title.ilike(f"%{_escape_like(q)}%", escape="\\"))
    if status in {"active", "archived"}:
        base = base.where(Conversation.status == status)

    stmt = (
        base.order_by(Conversation.last_message_at.desc().nullslast(), Conversation.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    stmt = _apply_cursor(stmt, decode_cursor(cursor))
    rows = (await db.execute(stmt)).all()
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items = [_conversation_out(row) for row in rows]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1][0]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor(
            {"t": last.last_message_at.isoformat() if last.last_message_at else None, "id": last.id}
        )

    stats_stmt = select(
        func.count(Conversation.id).label("total"),
        func.count(Conversation.id).filter(Conversation.status == "active").label("active"),
        func.count(Conversation.id).filter(Conversation.status == "archived").label("archived"),
    ).where(Conversation.user_id == user.id, Conversation.status != _DELETED)
    if q:
        stats_stmt = stats_stmt.where(
            Conversation.title.ilike(f"%{_escape_like(q)}%", escape="\\")
        )
    if status in {"active", "archived"}:
        stats_stmt = stats_stmt.where(Conversation.status == status)
    stats_row = (await db.execute(stats_stmt)).one()
    pending_total = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(func.distinct(Approval.id)))
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
        .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
        .where(
            Conversation.user_id == user.id,
            Conversation.status != _DELETED,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > _now()),
        )
    )
    return ConversationPage(
        items=items,
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
        stats={
            "total": int(stats_row.total),
            "active": int(stats_row.active),
            "archived": int(stats_row.archived),
            "pending_approval": int(pending_total or 0),
        },
    )


async def get_owned_conversation(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Conversation:
    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, conversation_id)
    if (
        conversation is None
        or conversation.user_id != user.id
        or conversation.status == _DELETED
    ):
        raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")
    return conversation


async def get_conversation_detail(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
) -> ConversationDetailOut:
    conversation = await get_owned_conversation(db, user, conversation_id)
    pending = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(Approval.id))
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
        .where(
            Run.conversation_id == conversation.id,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > _now()),
        )
    )
    last_run = await db.scalar(
        select(Run)
        .where(Run.conversation_id == conversation.id)
        .order_by(Run.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    base = ConversationOut(
        id=conversation.id,
        title=conversation.title,
        status="archived" if conversation.status == "archived" else "active",
        message_count=conversation.message_count,
        last_message_preview=conversation.last_message_preview,
        last_message_at=conversation.last_message_at,
        pending_approval_count=int(pending or 0),
        created_at=conversation.created_at,
        updated_at=conversation.updated_at,
    )
    return ConversationDetailOut(
        **base.model_dump(),
        archived_at=conversation.archived_at,
        last_run=(
            LastRunOut(
                id=last_run.id,
                status=last_run.status,
                model=last_run.model or None,
                finished_at=last_run.finished_at,
            )
            if last_run
            else None
        ),
    )


async def create_conversation(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: ConversationCreateRequest
) -> ConversationOut:
    conversation = Conversation(
        user_id=user.id,
        title=payload.title or "新对话",
    )
    db.add(conversation)
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(conversation)
    return _conversation_out((conversation, 0))


async def update_conversation(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: ConversationUpdateRequest,
) -> ConversationOut:
    conversation = await get_owned_conversation(db, user, conversation_id)
    if payload.title is not None:
        conversation.title = payload.title
    if payload.status is not None:
        conversation.status = payload.status
        conversation.archived_at = _now() if payload.status == "archived" else None
    await db.commit()
    await db.refresh(conversation)
    return _conversation_out((conversation, 0))


async def delete_conversation(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
) -> None:
    conversation = await get_owned_conversation(db, user, conversation_id)
    conversation.status = _DELETED
    conversation.archived_at = _now()
    await db.commit()


def _normalize_capabilities(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> MessageCapabilitiesOut:
    data = dict(raw or {})
    return MessageCapabilitiesOut(
        skills=[str(item) for item in data.get("skills", [])],
        mcp_servers=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_servers", [])],
        mcp_tools=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_tools", [])],
        knowledge_categories=[str(item) for item in data.get("knowledge_categories", [])],
        workflow_id=data.get("workflow_id"),
    )


def _message_out(message: Message) -> MessageOut:
    status = message.status if message.status in {"completed", "failed", "canceled"} else "canceled"
    usage = UsageOut(**message.usage) if message.usage else None
    error = MessageErrorOut(**message.error) if message.error else None
    return MessageOut(
        id=message.id,
        role=message.role,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        content=message.content,
        content_type=message.content_type,
        run_id=message.run_id,
        client_message_id=message.client_message_id,
        status=status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        citations=[CitationOut(**item) for item in (message.citations or [])],
        attachments=[MessageAttachmentOut(**item) for item in (message.attachments or [])],
        capabilities=_normalize_capabilities(message.capabilities),
        artifacts=[MessageArtifactOut(**item) for item in (message.artifacts or [])],
        usage=usage,
        error=error,
        created_at=message.created_at,
        metadata=message.metadata_ or {},
    )


def _apply_message_cursor(stmt, cursor: dict[str, Any]):
    if not cursor:
        return stmt
    raw_time = cursor.get("t")
    raw_id = cursor.get("id")
    try:
        last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
        last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
    if last_time is None or last_id is None:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
    return stmt.where(
        or_(
            Message.created_at < last_time,
            and_(Message.created_at == last_time, Message.id < last_id),
        )
    )


async def list_messages(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
    before: datetime | None,
) -> MessagePage:
    await get_owned_conversation(db, user, conversation_id)
    stmt = (
        select(Message)
        .where(Message.conversation_id == conversation_id)
        .order_by(Message.created_at.desc(), Message.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    if before is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Message.created_at < before)
    stmt = _apply_message_cursor(stmt, decode_cursor(cursor))
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})
    return MessagePage(
        items=[_message_out(item) for item in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
    )

from __future__ import annotations

import uuid
from datetime import datetime
from typing import Any, Literal

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, model_validator

ConversationStatus = Literal["active", "archived"]
MessageRole = Literal["user", "assistant", "tool", "system"]
MessageStatus = Literal["completed", "failed", "canceled"]


class LastRunOut(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    status: str
    model: str | None
    finished_at: datetime | None


class ConversationOut(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    title: str
    status: ConversationStatus
    message_count: int
    last_message_preview: str
    last_message_at: datetime | None
    pending_approval_count: int
    created_at: datetime
    updated_at: datetime


class ConversationDetailOut(ConversationOut):
    archived_at: datetime | None
    last_run: LastRunOut | None


class ConversationPage(BaseModel):
    items: list[ConversationOut]
    next_cursor: str | None
    has_more: bool
    stats: dict[str, int]


class ConversationCreateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=200)

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _normalize(self) -> ConversationCreateRequest:
        if self.title is not None:
            self.title = self.title.strip() or "新对话"
        return self


class ConversationUpdateRequest(BaseModel):
    title: str | None = Field(default=None, min_length=1, max_length=200)
    status: ConversationStatus | None = None

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _at_least_one(self) -> ConversationUpdateRequest:
        if self.title is None and self.status is None:
            raise ValueError("title 与 status 至少提供一个")
        if self.title is not None:
            self.title = self.title.strip()
        return self


class CitationOut(BaseModel):
    index: int
    document_id: str
    chunk_id: str
    title: str
    category: str
    score: float
    updated_at: datetime


class MessageAttachmentOut(BaseModel):
    id: str
    filename: str
    mime_type: str
    size_bytes: int


class MessageArtifactOut(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    mime_type: str
    size_bytes: int
    kind: str
    content: str | None = None
    download_url: str | None = None
    metadata: dict[str, Any] | None = None


class MessageCapabilitiesOut(BaseModel):
    skills: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    mcp_servers: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    mcp_tools: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    knowledge_categories: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
    workflow_id: str | None = None


class UsageOut(BaseModel):
    input_tokens: int = 0
    output_tokens: int = 0
    reasoning_tokens: int | None = None
    total_tokens: int | None = None


class MessageErrorOut(BaseModel):
    code: str
    message: str
    retryable: bool | None = None


class MessageOut(BaseModel):
    id: uuid.UUID
    role: MessageRole
    content: str
    content_type: str
    run_id: uuid.UUID | None
    client_message_id: str | None
    status: MessageStatus
    citations: list[CitationOut] = Field(default_factory=list)
    attachments: list[MessageAttachmentOut] = Field(default_factory=list)
    capabilities: MessageCapabilitiesOut = Field(default_factory=MessageCapabilitiesOut)
    artifacts: list[MessageArtifactOut] = Field(default_factory=list)
    usage: UsageOut | None = None
    error: MessageErrorOut | None = None
    created_at: datetime
    metadata: dict[str, Any] = Field(default_factory=dict)


class MessagePage(BaseModel):
    items: list[MessageOut]
    next_cursor: str | None
    has_more: bool
"}

def _apply_message_cursor(stmt, cursor: dict[str, Any]):
    if not cursor:
        return stmt
    raw_time = cursor.get("t")
    raw_id = cursor.get("id")
    try:
        last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
        last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
    except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效") from exc
    if last_time is None or last_id is None:
        raise ValidationFailedError("分页游标无效")
    return stmt.where(
        or_(
            Message.created_at < last_time,
            and_(Message.created_at == last_time, Message.id < last_id),
        )
    )


async def list_messages(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
    before: datetime | None,
) -> MessagePage:
    await get_owned_conversation(db, user, conversation_id)
    stmt = (
        select(Message)
        .where(Message.conversation_id == conversation_id)
        .order_by(Message.created_at.desc(), Message.id.desc())
        .limit(limit + 1)
    )
    if before is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Message.created_at < before)
    stmt = _apply_message_cursor(stmt, decode_cursor(cursor))
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})
    return MessagePage(
        items=[_message_out(item) for item in rows],
        next_cursor=next_cursor,
        has_more=has_more,
    )

SSE 连接与图执行解耦：客户端断开不影响运行，重连时先回放数据库事件再订阅实时事件。
单实例够用；多实例需要 Redis Stream 等共享总线（M6）。

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any


class RunEventBus:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._channels: dict[uuid.UUID, set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def subscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]:
        queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=2048)
        async with self._lock:
            self._channels[run_id].add(queue)
        return queue

    async def unsubscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            channel = self._channels.get(run_id)
            if channel is not None:
                channel.discard(queue)
                if not channel:
                    self._channels.pop(run_id, None)

    async def publish(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            subscribers = list(self._channels.get(run_id, ()))
        for queue in subscribers:
            try:
                queue.put_nowait(event)
            except asyncio.QueueFull:
                # 慢客户端不能阻塞图执行；丢弃实时帧，重连时靠回放补齐。
                continue


bus = RunEventBus()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker

from app.db.models.chat import RunEvent
from app.modules.chat.bus import RunEventBus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 结束事件：SSE 收到后可以关闭连接。
TERMINAL_EVENTS = {"message.done", "error"}


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def to_iso(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def format_sse(seq: int, event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
    # data 必须是单行；json.dumps 已转义换行。id 使用 run 内递增序号。
    return f"id: {seq}\nevent: {event}\ndata: {payload}\n\n"


def _event_payload(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {**body, "_event": body.pop("_event", "")} if "_event" in body else body


class RunEventPublisher:
    """为一次 run 生成单调递增的 seq，并先落库再广播。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        run_id: uuid.UUID,
        session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
        event_bus: RunEventBus,
        *,
        start_seq: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        self.run_id = run_id
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._bus = event_bus
        self.seq = start_seq

    async def emit(
        self,
        event: str,
        data: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        persist: bool = True,
        event_type: str = "message",
        status: str = "ok",
        title: str = "",
        subtitle: str = "",
        duration_ms: int | None = None,
        tokens: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.seq += 1
        ts = utc_now()
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "run_id": str(self.run_id),
            "ts": to_iso(ts),
            "seq": self.seq,
            **data,
        }
        if persist:
            payload = {**body, "_event": event}
            async with self._session_factory() as session:
                session.add(
                    RunEvent(
                        run_id=self.run_id,
                        seq=self.seq,
                        type=event_type,
                        status=status,
                        title=title[:200],
                        subtitle=subtitle[:200],
                        duration_ms=duration_ms,
                        tokens=tokens or {},
                        payload=payload,
                        error=error,
                        ts=ts,
                    )
                )
                await session.commit()
        await self._bus.publish(self.run_id, {"event": event, "data": body})
        return body
"}

SSE 连接与图执行解耦：客户端断开不影响运行，重连时先回放数据库事件再订阅实时事件。
单实例够用；多实例需要 Redis Stream 等共享总线（M6）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any


class RunEventBus:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._channels: dict[uuid.UUID, set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def subscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]:
        queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=2048)
        async with self._lock:
            self._channels[run_id].add(queue)
        return queue

    async def unsubscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            channel = self._channels.get(run_id)
            if channel is not None:
                channel.discard(queue)
                if not channel:
                    self._channels.pop(run_id, None)

    async def publish(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            subscribers = list(self._channels.get(run_id, ()))
        for queue in subscribers:
            try:
                queue.put_nowait(event)
            except asyncio.QueueFull:
                # 慢客户端不能阻塞图执行；丢弃实时帧，重连时靠回放补齐。
                continue


bus = RunEventBus()

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker

from app.db.models.chat import RunEvent
from app.modules.chat.bus import RunEventBus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 结束事件：SSE 收到后可以关闭连接。
TERMINAL_EVENTS = {"message.done", "error"}


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def to_iso(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def format_sse(seq: int, event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
    # data 必须是单行；json.dumps 已转义换行。id 使用 run 内递增序号。
    return f"id: {seq}\nevent: {event}\ndata: {payload}\n\n"


def _event_payload(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {**body, "_event": body.pop("_event", "")} if "_event" in body else body


class RunEventPublisher:
    """为一次 run 生成单调递增的 seq，并先落库再广播。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        run_id: uuid.UUID,
        session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
        event_bus: RunEventBus,
        *,
        start_seq: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        self.run_id = run_id
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._bus = event_bus
        self.seq = start_seq

    async def emit(
        self,
        event: str,
        data: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        persist: bool = True,
        event_type: str = "message",
        status: str = "ok",
        title: str = "",
        subtitle: str = "",
        duration_ms: int | None = None,
        tokens: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.seq += 1
        ts = utc_now()
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "run_id": str(self.run_id),
            "ts": to_iso(ts),
            "seq": self.seq,
            **data,
        }
        if persist:
            payload = {**body, "_event": event}
            async with self._session_factory() as session:
                session.add(
                    RunEvent(
                        run_id=self.run_id,
                        seq=self.seq,
                        type=event_type,
                        status=status,
                        title=title[:200],
                        subtitle=subtitle[:200],
                        duration_ms=duration_ms,
                        tokens=tokens or {},
                        payload=payload,
                        error=error,
                        ts=ts,
                    )
                )
                await session.commit()
        await self._bus.publish(self.run_id, {"event": event, "data": body})
        return body
"}

SSE 连接与图执行解耦：客户端断开不影响运行，重连时先回放数据库事件再订阅实时事件。
单实例够用；多实例需要 Redis Stream 等共享总线（M6）。

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import uuid
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import Any


class RunEventBus:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._channels: dict[uuid.UUID, set[asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]]] = defaultdict(set)
        self._lock = asyncio.Lock()

    async def subscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]:
        queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]] = asyncio.Queue(maxsize=2048)
        async with self._lock:
            self._channels[run_id].add(queue)
        return queue

    async def unsubscribe(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, queue: asyncio.Queue[dict[str, Any]]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            channel = self._channels.get(run_id)
            if channel is not None:
                channel.discard(queue)
                if not channel:
                    self._channels.pop(run_id, None)

    async def publish(self, run_id: uuid.UUID, event: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
        async with self._lock:
            subscribers = list(self._channels.get(run_id, ()))
        for queue in subscribers:
            try:
                queue.put_nowait(event)
            except asyncio.QueueFull:
                # 慢客户端不能阻塞图执行；丢弃实时帧，重连时靠回放补齐。
                continue


bus = RunEventBus()
"}

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession, async_sessionmaker

from app.db.models.chat import RunEvent
from app.modules.chat.bus import RunEventBus

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# 结束事件：SSE 收到后可以关闭连接。
TERMINAL_EVENTS = {"message.done", "error"}


def utc_now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def to_iso(value: datetime) -> str:
    return value.astimezone(UTC).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")


def format_sse(seq: int, event: str, data: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    payload = json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"), default=str)
    # data 必须是单行；json.dumps 已转义换行。id 使用 run 内递增序号。
    return f"id: {seq}\nevent: {event}\ndata: {payload}\n\n"


def _event_payload(body: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {**body, "_event": body.pop("_event", "")} if "_event" in body else body


class RunEventPublisher:
    """为一次 run 生成单调递增的 seq，并先落库再广播。"""

    def __init__(
        self,
        run_id: uuid.UUID,
        session_factory: async_sessionmaker[AsyncSession],
        event_bus: RunEventBus,
        *,
        start_seq: int = 0,
    ) -> None:
        self.run_id = run_id
        self._session_factory = session_factory
        self._bus = event_bus
        self.seq = start_seq

    async def emit(
        self,
        event: str,
        data: dict[str, Any],
        *,
        persist: bool = True,
        event_type: str = "message",
        status: str = "ok",
        title: str = "",
        subtitle: str = "",
        duration_ms: int | None = None,
        tokens: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
        error: dict[str, Any] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self.seq += 1
        ts = utc_now()
        body: dict[str, Any] = {
            "run_id": str(self.run_id),
            "ts": to_iso(ts),
            "seq": self.seq,
            **data,
        }
        if persist:
            payload = {**body, "_event": event}
            async with self._session_factory() as session:
                session.add(
                    RunEvent(
                        run_id=self.run_id,
                        seq=self.seq,
                        type=event_type,
                        status=status,
                        title=title[:200],
                        subtitle=subtitle[:200],
                        duration_ms=duration_ms,
                        tokens=tokens or {},
                        payload=payload,
                        error=error,
                        ts=ts,
                    )
                )
                await session.commit()
        await self._bus.publish(self.run_id, {"event": event, "data": body})
        return body
"}

def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _title_from_message(message: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join(message.split())
    return (text[:40] or "新对话")[:200]


def _normalize_capabilities(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> MessageCapabilitiesOut:
    data = {**_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES, **(raw or {})}
    return MessageCapabilitiesOut(
        skills=[str(item) for item in data.get("skills", [])],
        mcp_servers=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_servers", [])],
        mcp_tools=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_tools", [])],
        knowledge_categories=[str(item) for item in data.get("knowledge_categories", [])],
        workflow_id=data.get("workflow_id"),
    )


def _usage_dict(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
    raw = raw or {}
    input_tokens = int(raw.get("input_tokens") or 0)
    output_tokens = int(raw.get("output_tokens") or 0)
    reasoning_tokens = int(raw.get("reasoning_tokens") or 0)
    return {
        "input_tokens": input_tokens,
        "output_tokens": output_tokens,
        "reasoning_tokens": reasoning_tokens,
        "total_tokens": int(raw.get("total_tokens") or input_tokens + output_tokens),
    }


def _usage_out(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> UsageOut:
    data = _usage_dict(raw)
    return UsageOut(**data)


def _content_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("text"), str):
                parts.append(item["text"])
        return "".join(parts)
    return ""


def _check_m1_capabilities(payload: ChatStreamRequest) -> None:
    """M1 尚未实现的能力显式拒绝，避免前端出现“点了没效果”。"""
    if payload.skills or payload.mcp_servers or payload.mcp_tools:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能与 MCP 能力将在 M1.5 提供")
    if payload.knowledge_categories:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("知识库检索将在 M4 提供")
    if payload.attachments:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("附件上传尚未启用")
    if payload.workflow_id is not None:
        raise ConflictError("工作流能力尚未启用", code="workflow_disabled")


async def _load_owned_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> Run:
    run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise NotFoundError("运行不存在")
    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
    if conversation is None or conversation.user_id != user.id:
        raise NotFoundError("运行不存在")
    return run


async def _find_active_run(
    db: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Run | None:
    return await db.scalar(
        select(Run)
        .where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id, Run.status.in_(_ACTIVE_STATUSES))
        .order_by(Run.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )


async def start_chat(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: ChatStreamRequest
) -> ChatStartResult:
    settings = get_settings()
    model = payload.model or settings.llm_model
    if model not in settings.allowed_models:
        raise ValidationFailedError("该模型不在允许列表中", code="model_not_allowed")
    _check_m1_capabilities(payload)

    reasoning_effort = payload.reasoning_effort or "low"
    capabilities = {
        "skills": [str(item) for item in payload.skills],
        "mcp_servers": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_servers],
        "mcp_tools": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_tools],
        "knowledge_categories": list(payload.knowledge_categories),
        "workflow_id": str(payload.workflow_id) if payload.workflow_id else None,
    }

    is_new = payload.conversation_id is None
    if is_new:
        conversation = Conversation(
            user_id=user.id, title=_title_from_message(payload.message)
        )
        db.add(conversation)
        await db.flush()
    else:
        conversation = await db.scalar(
            select(Conversation)
            .where(
                Conversation.id == payload.conversation_id,
                Conversation.user_id == user.id,
                Conversation.status != "deleted",
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")
        if conversation.status == "archived":
            raise ConflictError("会话已归档，无法继续发送消息")

    # 幂等：同一个 client_message_id 直接复用已有 run，返回事件回放。
    if payload.client_message_id:
        existing = await db.scalar(
            select(Run).where(
                Run.conversation_id == conversation.id,
                Run.idempotency_key == payload.client_message_id,
            )
        )
        if existing is not None:
            await db.commit()
            return ChatStartResult(
                run_id=existing.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=True
            )

    active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
    if active is not None:
        raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id))

    now = _now()
    user_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="user",
        content=payload.message,
        content_type="text",
        client_message_id=payload.client_message_id,
        status="completed",
    )
    assistant_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="assistant",
        content="",
        content_type="markdown",
        status="streaming",
        capabilities=capabilities,
    )
    db.add_all([user_message, assistant_message])
    await db.flush()

    run = Run(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        user_message_id=user_message.id,
        assistant_message_id=assistant_message.id,
        source="user",
        status="running",
        model=model,
        reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort,
        capabilities=capabilities,
        idempotency_key=payload.client_message_id,
        started_at=now,
    )
    db.add(run)
    await db.flush()
    user_message.run_id = run.id
    assistant_message.run_id = run.id

    conversation.last_message_at = now
    conversation.last_message_preview = payload.message[:80]
    conversation.message_count += 1
    if is_new or conversation.title == "新对话":
        conversation.title = _title_from_message(payload.message)

    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
        if active is not None:
            raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id)) from exc
        raise ConflictError("发送消息冲突，请重试") from exc

    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run.id, get_session_factory(), bus)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run.id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.register(context)
    registry.start(context, execute_run(context, is_new))
    return ChatStartResult(
        run_id=run.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=False
    )


async def execute_run(context: RunContext, is_new_conversation: bool) -> None:
    """后台运行：独立于 SSE 连接，客户端断开不影响执行。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    run_id = context.run_id
    publisher = context.publisher
    started_wall = _now()
    started_at: datetime | None = None
    first_token_ms: int | None = None
    content_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
    usage: dict[str, Any] = {}

    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None or run.status != "running":
                return
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            user_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.user_message_id) if run.user_message_id else None
            )
            assistant_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
                if run.assistant_message_id
                else None
            )
            if conversation is None or user_message is None or assistant_message is None:
                raise RuntimeError("运行关联数据不存在")
            started_at = run.started_at or started_wall
            conversation_id = conversation.id
            conversation_title = conversation.title
            user_message_id = user_message.id
            assistant_message_id = assistant_message.id
            user_message_created = user_message.created_at
            user_text = user_message.content
            client_message_id = user_message.client_message_id or ""
            requested_effort = run.reasoning_effort or "low"
            model_name = run.model

        if is_new_conversation:
            await publisher.emit(
                "conversation.created",
                {"conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "title": conversation_title},
                event_type="message",
                title="创建会话",
            )
        await publisher.emit(
            "run.started",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
                "user_message_id": str(user_message_id),
                "client_message_id": client_message_id,
                "model": model_name,
                "reasoning_effort": requested_effort,
                "workflow_id": None,
                "workflow_version": None,
            },
            event_type="request",
            title="用户请求",
            subtitle=user_text[:80],
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.created",
            {
                "message_id": str(user_message_id),
                "role": "user",
                "client_message_id": client_message_id,
                "created_at": to_iso(user_message_created),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="用户消息",
            subtitle=user_text[:80],
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.started",
            {
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                "role": "assistant",
                "started_at": to_iso(_now()),
            },
            event_type="message",
            status="running",
            title="助手消息",
        )

        model = build_chat_model(settings)
        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = build_graph(model, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(conversation_id)}}
            async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
                {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_text)]},
                config,
                stream_mode="messages",
            ):
                if context.cancel_requested:
                    raise asyncio.CancelledError
                if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
                    continue
                if not isinstance(chunk, AIMessageChunk):
                    continue

                reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
                if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
                    if reasoning_started is None:
                        reasoning_started = _now()
                    reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "reasoning.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
                        persist=False,
                    )

                text = _content_text(chunk.content)
                if text:
                    if first_token_ms is None:
                        first_token_ms = int((_now() - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
                    content_parts.append(text)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "message.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": text},
                        persist=False,
                    )
                if chunk.usage_metadata:
                    usage = dict(chunk.usage_metadata)

            snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
            messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
            if messages:
                final_message = messages[-1]
                final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
                if final_text and not content_parts:
                    content_parts.append(final_text)
                if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None):
                    usage = dict(final_message.usage_metadata)

        now = _now()
        duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
        notes = _usage_dict(usage)
        content = "".join(content_parts)

        if reasoning_parts:
            reasoning_text = "".join(reasoning_parts)
            await publisher.emit(
                "reasoning.done",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                    "duration_ms": int(
                        ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
                    ),
                    "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                    "summary": reasoning_text[:2000],
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="思考摘要",
            )

        await _finalize_success(
            run_id=run_id,
            assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
            content=content,
            usage=notes,
            first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            finished_at=now,
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.done",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                "usage": notes,
                "finish_reason": "stop",
                "model": model_name,
                "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "citations": [],
                "artifacts": [],
                "reasoning": (
                    {
                        "duration_ms": int(
                            ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
                        ),
                        "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                        "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                    }
                    if reasoning_parts
                    else None
                ),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="助手回复",
            subtitle=content[:80],
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            tokens=notes,
        )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,
            )
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 后台任务必须兜底，避免静默丢失
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,
                error=exc,
            )
        )


async def _finalize_success(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    assistant_message_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    duration_ms: int,
    finished_at: datetime,
) -> None:
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        assistant = await db.get(Message, assistant_message_id)
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "completed"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is not None:
            run.status = "succeeded"
            run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
            run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
            run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
            run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
            run.duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.finished_at = finished_at
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            if conversation is not None:
                conversation.last_message_at = finished_at
                conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80]
                conversation.message_count += 1
        await db.commit()


async def _finalize_canceled(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "canceled"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run.status = "canceled"
        run.canceled_at = now
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
        run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
        run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
        if conversation is not None:
            conversation.last_message_at = now
            conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80] or "（已取消）"
        await db.commit()
        message_id = run.assistant_message_id
        model_name = run.model

    await publisher.emit(
        "message.done",
        {
            "message_id": str(message_id) if message_id else "",
            "usage": usage,
            "finish_reason": "canceled",
            "model": model_name,
            "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "citations": [],
            "artifacts": [],
        },
        event_type="message",
        status="canceled",
        title="已取消",
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
        tokens=usage,
    )


async def _finalize_failed(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
    error: Exception,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    message = "模型调用失败，请稍后重试"
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "failed"
            assistant.usage = usage
            assistant.error = {"code": "llm_error", "message": message, "retryable": True}
        run.status = "failed"
        run.error_code = "llm_error"
        run.error_message = message
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        await db.commit()

    await publisher.emit(
        "error",
        {
            "code": "llm_error",
            "message": message,
            "request_id": current_request_id(),
            "run_id": str(run_id),
            "retryable": True,
        },
        event_type="error",
        status="error",
        title="运行失败",
        error={"code": "llm_error", "message": message},
    )


async def get_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunOut:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = (
        int((run.finished_at - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
        if run.finished_at and started_at
        else int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    )
    usage = _usage_out(
        {
            "input_tokens": run.input_tokens,
            "output_tokens": run.output_tokens,
            "reasoning_tokens": run.reasoning_tokens,
            "total_tokens": run.input_tokens + run.output_tokens,
        }
    )
    pending = await db.scalar(
        select(Approval)
        .where(
            Approval.run_id == run.id,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > now),
        )
        .order_by(Approval.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    pending_out = RunPendingOut()
    if pending is not None:
        pending_out = RunPendingOut(kind="approval", approval_id=pending.id)
    error = (
        MessageErrorOut(code=run.error_code, message=run.error_message, retryable=True)
        if run.error_code
        else None
    )
    return RunOut(
        id=run.id,
        conversation_id=run.conversation_id,
        status=run.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        source=run.source,
        model=run.model or None,
        reasoning_effort=run.reasoning_effort,
        workflow=None,
        capabilities=_normalize_capabilities(run.capabilities),
        usage=usage,
        started_at=run.started_at,
        finished_at=run.finished_at,
        duration_ms=run.duration_ms or duration_ms,
        active_duration_ms=run.active_duration_ms or duration_ms,
        first_token_ms=run.first_token_ms,
        pending=pending_out,
        message_ids=RunMessageIdsOut(
            user=run.user_message_id, assistant=run.assistant_message_id
        ),
        agents=(
            [
                RunAgentOut(
                    kind="local",
                    id="main-agent",
                    name="main-agent",
                    model=run.model or None,
                    state="online" if run.status == "running" else "idle",
                )
            ]
            if run.model
            else []
        ),
        error=error,
    )


async def list_run_events(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    after_seq: int | None,
    types: str | None,
    q: str | None,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> RunEventPage:
    await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    stmt = select(RunEvent).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id).order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
    if after_seq is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > after_seq)
    if cursor:
        from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor

        raw = decode_cursor(cursor).get("seq")
        if isinstance(raw, int):
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > raw)
    if types:
        allowed = [item.strip() for item in types.split(",") if item.strip()]
        if allowed:
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.type.in_(allowed))
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(RunEvent.title.ilike(pattern), RunEvent.subtitle.ilike(pattern))
        )
    stmt = stmt.limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items: list[RunEventOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        payload = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
        error_message = None
        if isinstance(row.error, dict):
            error_message = str(row.error.get("message") or "")
        items.append(
            RunEventOut(
                id=f"{run_id}:{row.seq}",
                seq=row.seq,
                ts=row.ts,
                type=row.type,
                status=row.status,
                title=row.title,
                subtitle=row.subtitle,
                duration_ms=row.duration_ms,
                tokens=row.tokens or None,
                payload=payload,
                error=error_message,
            )
        )
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"seq": rows[-1].seq})
    return RunEventPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more)


async def cancel_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunCancelResult:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status not in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
        raise RunNotCancelableError(run.status)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    run.status = "canceled"
    run.canceled_at = now
    run.finished_at = now
    run.duration_ms = duration_ms
    run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
    await db.execute(
        update(Message)
        .where(Message.run_id == run_id, Message.status == "streaming")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.execute(
        update(Approval)
        .where(Approval.run_id == run_id, Approval.status == "pending")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.commit()
    registry.cancel(run_id)
    return RunCancelResult(id=run.id, status="canceled", canceled_at=now)


async def resume_run(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID, user_input: str
) -> RunResumeResult:
    del user_input
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status != "interrupted":
        raise ConflictError("当前运行不处于等待输入状态", code="run_not_resumable")
    # M1 还没有会触发 interrupt 的工具；保留端点形状，接入 A2A/MCP 后实现 Command(resume)。
    raise ConflictError("当前版本不支持恢复运行", code="run_not_resumable")


async def stream_run_events(
    run_id: uuid.UUID, *, after_seq: int = 0
) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """SSE 生成器：先回放已落库事件，再跟随实时事件。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    queue = await bus.subscribe(run_id)
    last_seq = after_seq
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            rows = list(
                (
                    await db.execute(
                        select(RunEvent)
                        .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id, RunEvent.seq > last_seq)
                        .order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
                    )
                )
                .scalars()
                .all()
            )
        for row in rows:
            if row.seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            event_name = str((row.payload or {}).get("_event") or "")
            if not event_name:
                continue
            data = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
            last_seq = row.seq
            yield format_sse(row.seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return

        idle_seconds = 0
        heartbeat_seconds = 15
        while True:
            try:
                item = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=heartbeat_seconds)
            except TimeoutError:
                idle_seconds += heartbeat_seconds
                if idle_seconds >= settings.hitl_stream_timeout_seconds:
                    logger.info("SSE 等待超时 run_id=%s", run_id)
                    return
                yield ": ping\n\n"
                continue
            idle_seconds = 0
            data = item.get("data", {})
            seq = int(data.get("seq") or 0)
            if seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            last_seq = seq
            event_name = str(item.get("event") or "")
            yield format_sse(seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return
    finally:
        await bus.unsubscribe(run_id, queue)


async def has_run_events(db: AsyncSession, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(RunEvent.id)).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)
    )
    return bool(count)


async def replay_only(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """幂等重放：如果 run 已结束且已有终态事件，直接回放后关闭。"""
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        if run.status in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
            return False
        event = await db.scalar(
            select(RunEvent)
            .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)
            .order_by(RunEvent.seq.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        return bool(event)


def run_status_of(value: str) -> RunStatus:
    return value  # type: ignore[return-value]

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.core.cursor import encode_cursor

)

)
from app.modules.conversations.schemas import (
    MessageCapabilitiesOut,
    MessageErrorOut,
    UsageOut,
)

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

_ACTIVE_STATUSES = ("queued", "running", "interrupted")
_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES: dict[str, Any] = {
    "skills": [],
    "mcp_servers": [],
    "mcp_tools": [],
    "knowledge_categories": [],
    "workflow_id": None,
}


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _title_from_message(message: str) -> str:
    text = " ".join(message.split())
    return (text[:40] or "新对话")[:200]


def _normalize_capabilities(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> MessageCapabilitiesOut:
    data = {**_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES, **(raw or {})}
    return MessageCapabilitiesOut(
        skills=[str(item) for item in data.get("skills", [])],
        mcp_servers=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_servers", [])],
        mcp_tools=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_tools", [])],
        knowledge_categories=[str(item) for item in data.get("knowledge_categories", [])],
        workflow_id=data.get("workflow_id"),
    )


def _usage_dict(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
    raw = raw or {}
    input_tokens = int(raw.get("input_tokens") or 0)
    output_tokens = int(raw.get("output_tokens") or 0)
    reasoning_tokens = int(raw.get("reasoning_tokens") or 0)
    return {
        "input_tokens": input_tokens,
        "output_tokens": output_tokens,
        "reasoning_tokens": reasoning_tokens,
        "total_tokens": int(raw.get("total_tokens") or input_tokens + output_tokens),
    }


def _usage_out(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> UsageOut:
    data = _usage_dict(raw)
    return UsageOut(**data)


def _content_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("text"), str):
                parts.append(item["text"])
        return "".join(parts)
    return ""


def _check_m1_capabilities(payload: ChatStreamRequest) -> None:
    """M1 尚未实现的能力显式拒绝，避免前端出现“点了没效果”。"""
    if payload.skills or payload.mcp_servers or payload.mcp_tools:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("技能与 MCP 能力将在 M1.5 提供")
    if payload.knowledge_categories:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("知识库检索将在 M4 提供")
    if payload.attachments:
        raise CapabilityDisabledError("附件上传尚未启用")
    if payload.workflow_id is not None:
        raise ConflictError("工作流能力尚未启用", code="workflow_disabled")


async def _load_owned_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> Run:
    run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
    if run is None:
        raise NotFoundError("运行不存在")
    conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
    if conversation is None or conversation.user_id != user.id:
        raise NotFoundError("运行不存在")
    return run


async def _find_active_run(
    db: AsyncSession, conversation_id: uuid.UUID
) -> Run | None:
    return await db.scalar(
        select(Run)
        .where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id, Run.status.in_(_ACTIVE_STATUSES))
        .order_by(Run.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )


async def start_chat(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: ChatStreamRequest
) -> ChatStartResult:
    settings = get_settings()
    model = payload.model or settings.llm_model
    if model not in settings.allowed_models:
        raise ValidationFailedError("该模型不在允许列表中", code="model_not_allowed")
    _check_m1_capabilities(payload)

    reasoning_effort = payload.reasoning_effort or "low"
    capabilities = {
        "skills": [str(item) for item in payload.skills],
        "mcp_servers": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_servers],
        "mcp_tools": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_tools],
        "knowledge_categories": list(payload.knowledge_categories),
        "workflow_id": str(payload.workflow_id) if payload.workflow_id else None,
    }

    is_new = payload.conversation_id is None
    if is_new:
        conversation = Conversation(
            user_id=user.id, title=_title_from_message(payload.message)
        )
        db.add(conversation)
        await db.flush()
    else:
        conversation = await db.scalar(
            select(Conversation)
            .where(
                Conversation.id == payload.conversation_id,
                Conversation.user_id == user.id,
                Conversation.status != "deleted",
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")
        if conversation.status == "archived":
            raise ConflictError("会话已归档，无法继续发送消息")

    # 幂等：同一个 client_message_id 直接复用已有 run，返回事件回放。
    if payload.client_message_id:
        existing = await db.scalar(
            select(Run).where(
                Run.conversation_id == conversation.id,
                Run.idempotency_key == payload.client_message_id,
            )
        )
        if existing is not None:
            await db.commit()
            return ChatStartResult(
                run_id=existing.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=True
            )

    active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
    if active is not None:
        raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id))

    now = _now()
    user_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="user",
        content=payload.message,
        content_type="text",
        client_message_id=payload.client_message_id,
        status="completed",
    )
    assistant_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="assistant",
        content="",
        content_type="markdown",
        status="streaming",
        capabilities=capabilities,
    )
    db.add_all([user_message, assistant_message])
    await db.flush()

    run = Run(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        user_message_id=user_message.id,
        assistant_message_id=assistant_message.id,
        source="user",
        status="running",
        model=model,
        reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort,
        capabilities=capabilities,
        idempotency_key=payload.client_message_id,
        started_at=now,
    )
    db.add(run)
    await db.flush()
    user_message.run_id = run.id
    assistant_message.run_id = run.id

    conversation.last_message_at = now
    conversation.last_message_preview = payload.message[:80]
    conversation.message_count += 1
    if is_new or conversation.title == "新对话":
        conversation.title = _title_from_message(payload.message)

    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
        if active is not None:
            raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id)) from exc
        raise ConflictError("发送消息冲突，请重试") from exc

    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run.id, get_session_factory(), bus)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run.id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.register(context)
    registry.start(context, execute_run(context, is_new))
    return ChatStartResult(
        run_id=run.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=False
    )


async def execute_run(context: RunContext, is_new_conversation: bool) -> None:
    """后台运行：独立于 SSE 连接，客户端断开不影响执行。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    run_id = context.run_id
    publisher = context.publisher
    started_wall = _now()
    started_at: datetime | None = None
    first_token_ms: int | None = None
    content_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
    usage: dict[str, Any] = {}

    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None or run.status != "running":
                return
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            user_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.user_message_id) if run.user_message_id else None
            )
            assistant_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
                if run.assistant_message_id
                else None
            )
            if conversation is None or user_message is None or assistant_message is None:
                raise RuntimeError("运行关联数据不存在")
            started_at = run.started_at or started_wall
            conversation_id = conversation.id
            conversation_title = conversation.title
            user_message_id = user_message.id
            assistant_message_id = assistant_message.id
            user_message_created = user_message.created_at
            user_text = user_message.content
            client_message_id = user_message.client_message_id or ""
            requested_effort = run.reasoning_effort or "low"
            model_name = run.model

        if is_new_conversation:
            await publisher.emit(
                "conversation.created",

        await publisher.emit(

        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:

            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(conversation_id)}}
            async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
                {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_text)]},

                    raise asyncio.CancelledError
                if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
                    continue
                if not isinstance(chunk, AIMessageChunk):

                reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
                if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
                    if reasoning_started is None:
                        reasoning_started = _now()
                    reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "reasoning.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
                        persist=False,
                    )

                text = _content_text(chunk.content)
                if text:
                    if first_token_ms is None:
                        first_token_ms = int((_now() - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
                    content_parts.append(text)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "message.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": text},

                    )

            messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
            if messages:
                final_message = messages[-1]
                final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
                if final_text and not content_parts:
                    content_parts.append(final_text)
                if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None):

        now = _now()
        duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)

                    ),

        await _finalize_success(
            run_id=run_id,
            assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
            content=content,
            usage=notes,
            first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            finished_at=now,
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.done",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                "usage": notes,
                "finish_reason": "stop",
                "model": model_name,
                "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "citations": [],
                "artifacts": [],
                "reasoning": (
                    {
                        "duration_ms": int(
                            ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
                        ),
                        "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                        "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                    }

                    else None

            event_type="message",
            title="助手回复",
            subtitle=content[:80],
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            tokens=notes,
        )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),

                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,

        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 后台任务必须兜底，避免静默丢失
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,
                error=exc,
            )
        )


async def _finalize_success(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    assistant_message_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    duration_ms: int,
    finished_at: datetime,
) -> None:
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        assistant = await db.get(Message, assistant_message_id)
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "completed"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is not None:
            run.status = "succeeded"
            run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
            run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
            run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
            run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
            run.duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.finished_at = finished_at
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            if conversation is not None:
                conversation.last_message_at = finished_at
                conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80]
                conversation.message_count += 1
        await db.commit()


async def _finalize_canceled(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "canceled"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run.status = "canceled"
        run.canceled_at = now
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
        run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
        run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
        if conversation is not None:
            conversation.last_message_at = now
            conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80] or "（已取消）"
        await db.commit()
        message_id = run.assistant_message_id
        model_name = run.model

    await publisher.emit(
        "message.done",
        {
            "message_id": str(message_id) if message_id else "",
            "usage": usage,
            "finish_reason": "canceled",
            "model": model_name,
            "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "citations": [],
            "artifacts": [],
        },
        event_type="message",
        status="canceled",
        title="已取消",
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
        tokens=usage,
    )


async def _finalize_failed(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
    error: Exception,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    message = "模型调用失败，请稍后重试"
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "failed"
            assistant.usage = usage
            assistant.error = {"code": "llm_error", "message": message, "retryable": True}

        run.error_code = "llm_error"
        run.error_message = message
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        await db.commit()

    await publisher.emit(
        "error",
        {
            "code": "llm_error",
            "message": message,
            "request_id": current_request_id(),
            "run_id": str(run_id),
