async def get_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunOut:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = (
        int((run.finished_at - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
        if run.finished_at and started_at
        else int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    )
    usage = _usage_out(
        {
            "input_tokens": run.input_tokens,
            "output_tokens": run.output_tokens,
            "reasoning_tokens": run.reasoning_tokens,
            "total_tokens": run.input_tokens + run.output_tokens,
        }
    )
    pending = await db.scalar(
        select(Approval)
        .where(
            Approval.run_id == run.id,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > now),
        )
        .order_by(Approval.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    pending_out = RunPendingOut()
    if pending is not None:
        pending_out = RunPendingOut(kind="approval", approval_id=pending.id)
    error = (
        MessageErrorOut(code=run.error_code, message=run.error_message, retryable=True)
        if run.error_code
        else None
    )
    return RunOut(
        id=run.id,
        conversation_id=run.conversation_id,
        status=run.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        source=run.source,
        model=run.model or None,
        reasoning_effort=run.reasoning_effort,
        workflow=None,
        capabilities=_normalize_capabilities(run.capabilities),
        usage=usage,
        started_at=run.started_at,
        finished_at=run.finished_at,
        duration_ms=run.duration_ms or duration_ms,
        active_duration_ms=run.active_duration_ms or duration_ms,
        first_token_ms=run.first_token_ms,
        pending=pending_out,
        message_ids=RunMessageIdsOut(
            user=run.user_message_id, assistant=run.assistant_message_id
        ),
        agents=(
            [
                RunAgentOut(
                    kind="local",
                    id="main-agent",
                    name="main-agent",
                    model=run.model or None,
                    state="online" if run.status == "running" else "idle",
                )
            ]
            if run.model
            else []
        ),
        error=error,
    )


async def list_run_events(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    after_seq: int | None,
    types: str | None,
    q: str | None,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> RunEventPage:
    await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    stmt = select(RunEvent).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id).order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
    if after_seq is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > after_seq)
    if cursor:
        from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor

        raw = decode_cursor(cursor).get("seq")
        if isinstance(raw, int):
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > raw)
    if types:
        allowed = [item.strip() for item in types.split(",") if item.strip()]
        if allowed:
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.type.in_(allowed))
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(RunEvent.title.ilike(pattern), RunEvent.subtitle.ilike(pattern))
        )
    stmt = stmt.limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items: list[RunEventOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        payload = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
        error_message = None
        if isinstance(row.error, dict):
            error_message = str(row.error.get("message") or "")
        items.append(
            RunEventOut(
                id=f"{run_id}:{row.seq}",
                seq=row.seq,
                ts=row.ts,
                type=row.type,
                status=row.status,
                title=row.title,
                subtitle=row.subtitle,
                duration_ms=row.duration_ms,
                tokens=row.tokens or None,
                payload=payload,
                error=error_message,
            )
        )
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"seq": rows[-1].seq})
    return RunEventPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more)


async def cancel_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunCancelResult:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status not in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
        raise RunNotCancelableError(run.status)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    run.status = "canceled"
    run.canceled_at = now
    run.finished_at = now
    run.duration_ms = duration_ms
    run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
    await db.execute(
        update(Message)
        .where(Message.run_id == run_id, Message.status == "streaming")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.execute(
        update(Approval)
        .where(Approval.run_id == run_id, Approval.status == "pending")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.commit()
    registry.cancel(run_id)
    return RunCancelResult(id=run.id, status="canceled", canceled_at=now)


async def resume_run(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID, user_input: str
) -> RunResumeResult:
    del user_input
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status != "interrupted":
        raise ConflictError("当前运行不处于等待输入状态", code="run_not_resumable")
    # M1 还没有会触发 interrupt 的工具；保留端点形状，接入 A2A/MCP 后实现 Command(resume)。
    raise ConflictError("当前版本不支持恢复运行", code="run_not_resumable")


async def stream_run_events(
    run_id: uuid.UUID, *, after_seq: int = 0
) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """SSE 生成器：先回放已落库事件，再跟随实时事件。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    queue = await bus.subscribe(run_id)
    last_seq = after_seq
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            rows = list(
                (
                    await db.execute(
                        select(RunEvent)
                        .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id, RunEvent.seq > last_seq)
                        .order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
                    )
                )
                .scalars()
                .all()
            )
        for row in rows:
            if row.seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            event_name = str((row.payload or {}).get("_event") or "")
            if not event_name:
                continue
            data = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
            last_seq = row.seq
            yield format_sse(row.seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return

        idle_seconds = 0
        heartbeat_seconds = 15
        while True:
            try:
                item = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=heartbeat_seconds)
            except TimeoutError:
                idle_seconds += heartbeat_seconds
                if idle_seconds >= settings.hitl_stream_timeout_seconds:
                    logger.info("SSE 等待超时 run_id=%s", run_id)
                    return
                yield ": ping\n\n"
                continue
            idle_seconds = 0
            data = item.get("data", {})
            seq = int(data.get("seq") or 0)
            if seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            last_seq = seq
            event_name = str(item.get("event") or "")
            yield format_sse(seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return
    finally:
        await bus.unsubscribe(run_id, queue)


async def has_run_events(db: AsyncSession, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(RunEvent.id)).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)
    )
    return bool(count)


async def replay_only(run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    """幂等重放：如果 run 已结束且已有终态事件，直接回放后关闭。"""
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        if run.status in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
            return False
        event = await db.scalar(
            select(RunEvent)
            .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)
            .order_by(RunEvent.seq.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        return bool(event)

    return value  # type: ignore[return-value]

def _now() -> datetime:

def _normalize_capabilities(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> MessageCapabilitiesOut:
    data = {**_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES, **(raw or {})}
    return MessageCapabilitiesOut(
        skills=[str(item) for item in data.get("skills", [])],
        mcp_servers=[str(item) for item in data.get("mcp_servers", [])],

    )


def _usage_dict(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> dict[str, int]:
    raw = raw or {}
    input_tokens = int(raw.get("input_tokens") or 0)
    output_tokens = int(raw.get("output_tokens") or 0)
    reasoning_tokens = int(raw.get("reasoning_tokens") or 0)
    return {
        "input_tokens": input_tokens,
        "output_tokens": output_tokens,
        "reasoning_tokens": reasoning_tokens,
        "total_tokens": int(raw.get("total_tokens") or input_tokens + output_tokens),
    }


def _usage_out(raw: dict[str, Any] | None) -> UsageOut:

    return UsageOut(**data)


def _content_text(content: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(content, str):
        return content
    if isinstance(content, list):
        parts: list[str] = []
        for item in content:
            if isinstance(item, str):
                parts.append(item)
            elif isinstance(item, dict) and isinstance(item.get("text"), str):
                parts.append(item["text"])
        return "".join(parts)
    return ""

    return await db.scalar(
        select(Run)
        .where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id, Run.status.in_(_ACTIVE_STATUSES))
        .order_by(Run.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )


async def start_chat(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, payload: ChatStreamRequest
) -> ChatStartResult:
    settings = get_settings()
    model = payload.model or settings.llm_model
    if model not in settings.allowed_models:
        raise ValidationFailedError("该模型不在允许列表中", code="model_not_allowed")
    _check_m1_capabilities(payload)

    reasoning_effort = payload.reasoning_effort or "low"
    capabilities = {
        "skills": [str(item) for item in payload.skills],
        "mcp_servers": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_servers],
        "mcp_tools": [str(item) for item in payload.mcp_tools],
        "knowledge_categories": list(payload.knowledge_categories),
        "workflow_id": str(payload.workflow_id) if payload.workflow_id else None,
    }

    is_new = payload.conversation_id is None
    if is_new:
        conversation = Conversation(
            user_id=user.id, title=_title_from_message(payload.message)
        )
        db.add(conversation)
        await db.flush()
    else:
        conversation = await db.scalar(
            select(Conversation)
            .where(
                Conversation.id == payload.conversation_id,
                Conversation.user_id == user.id,
                Conversation.status != "deleted",
            )
            .with_for_update()
        )
        if conversation is None:
            raise NotFoundError("会话不存在")
        if conversation.status == "archived":
            raise ConflictError("会话已归档，无法继续发送消息")

    # 幂等：同一个 client_message_id 直接复用已有 run，返回事件回放。
    if payload.client_message_id:
        existing = await db.scalar(
            select(Run).where(
                Run.conversation_id == conversation.id,
                Run.idempotency_key == payload.client_message_id,
            )
        )
        if existing is not None:
            await db.commit()
            return ChatStartResult(
                run_id=existing.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=True
            )

    active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
    if active is not None:
        raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id))

    now = _now()
    user_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="user",
        content=payload.message,
        content_type="text",
        client_message_id=payload.client_message_id,
        status="completed",
    )
    assistant_message = Message(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        role="assistant",
        content="",
        content_type="markdown",
        status="streaming",
        capabilities=capabilities,
    )
    db.add_all([user_message, assistant_message])
    await db.flush()

    run = Run(
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        user_message_id=user_message.id,
        assistant_message_id=assistant_message.id,
        source="user",
        status="running",
        model=model,
        reasoning_effort=reasoning_effort,
        capabilities=capabilities,
        idempotency_key=payload.client_message_id,
        started_at=now,
    )
    db.add(run)
    await db.flush()
    user_message.run_id = run.id
    assistant_message.run_id = run.id

    conversation.last_message_at = now
    conversation.last_message_preview = payload.message[:80]
    conversation.message_count += 1
    if is_new or conversation.title == "新对话":
        conversation.title = _title_from_message(payload.message)

    try:
        await db.commit()
    except IntegrityError as exc:
        await db.rollback()
        active = await _find_active_run(db, conversation.id)
        if active is not None:
            raise RunInProgressError(str(active.id)) from exc
        raise ConflictError("发送消息冲突，请重试") from exc

    publisher = RunEventPublisher(run.id, get_session_factory(), bus)
    context = RunContext(run_id=run.id, publisher=publisher)
    registry.register(context)
    registry.start(context, execute_run(context, is_new))
    return ChatStartResult(
        run_id=run.id, conversation_id=conversation.id, replay=False
    )


async def execute_run(context: RunContext, is_new_conversation: bool) -> None:
    """后台运行：独立于 SSE 连接，客户端断开不影响执行。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    run_id = context.run_id
    publisher = context.publisher
    started_wall = _now()
    started_at: datetime | None = None
    first_token_ms: int | None = None
    content_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_parts: list[str] = []
    reasoning_started: datetime | None = None
    usage: dict[str, Any] = {}

    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
            if run is None or run.status != "running":
                return
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            user_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.user_message_id) if run.user_message_id else None
            )
            assistant_message = (
                await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
                if run.assistant_message_id
                else None
            )
            if conversation is None or user_message is None or assistant_message is None:
                raise RuntimeError("运行关联数据不存在")
            started_at = run.started_at or started_wall
            conversation_id = conversation.id
            conversation_title = conversation.title
            user_message_id = user_message.id
            assistant_message_id = assistant_message.id
            user_message_created = user_message.created_at
            user_text = user_message.content
            client_message_id = user_message.client_message_id or ""
            requested_effort = run.reasoning_effort or "low"
            model_name = run.model

        if is_new_conversation:
            await publisher.emit(
                "conversation.created",
                {"conversation_id": str(conversation_id), "title": conversation_title},
                event_type="message",
                title="创建会话",
            )
        await publisher.emit(
            "run.started",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
                "user_message_id": str(user_message_id),
                "client_message_id": client_message_id,
                "model": model_name,
                "reasoning_effort": requested_effort,
                "workflow_id": None,
                "workflow_version": None,
            },
            event_type="request",
            title="用户请求",
            subtitle=user_text[:80],
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.created",
            {
                "message_id": str(user_message_id),
                "role": "user",
                "client_message_id": client_message_id,
                "created_at": to_iso(user_message_created),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="用户消息",
            subtitle=user_text[:80],
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.started",
            {
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                "role": "assistant",
                "started_at": to_iso(_now()),
            },
            event_type="message",
            status="running",
            title="助手消息",
        )

        model = build_chat_model(settings)
        async with open_checkpointer() as saver:
            graph = build_graph(model, saver)
            config = {"configurable": {"thread_id": str(conversation_id)}}
            async for chunk, metadata in graph.astream(
                {"messages": [HumanMessage(content=user_text)]},
                config,
                stream_mode="messages",
            ):
                if context.cancel_requested:
                    raise asyncio.CancelledError
                if metadata.get("langgraph_node") != "model":
                    continue
                if not isinstance(chunk, AIMessageChunk):
                    continue

                reasoning = chunk.additional_kwargs.get("reasoning_content")
                if isinstance(reasoning, str) and reasoning:
                    if reasoning_started is None:
                        reasoning_started = _now()
                    reasoning_parts.append(reasoning)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "reasoning.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": reasoning},
                        persist=False,
                    )

                text = _content_text(chunk.content)
                if text:
                    if first_token_ms is None:
                        first_token_ms = int((_now() - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
                    content_parts.append(text)
                    await publisher.emit(
                        "message.delta",
                        {"message_id": str(assistant_message_id), "delta": text},
                        persist=False,
                    )
                if chunk.usage_metadata:
                    usage = dict(chunk.usage_metadata)

            snapshot = await graph.aget_state(config)
            messages = snapshot.values.get("messages", [])
            if messages:
                final_message = messages[-1]
                final_text = _content_text(getattr(final_message, "content", ""))
                if final_text and not content_parts:
                    content_parts.append(final_text)
                if getattr(final_message, "usage_metadata", None):
                    usage = dict(final_message.usage_metadata)

        now = _now()
        duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
        notes = _usage_dict(usage)
        content = "".join(content_parts)

        if reasoning_parts:
            reasoning_text = "".join(reasoning_parts)
            await publisher.emit(
                "reasoning.done",
                {
                    "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                    "duration_ms": int(
                        ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
                    ),
                    "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                    "summary": reasoning_text[:2000],
                },
                event_type="message",
                title="思考摘要",
            )

        await _finalize_success(
            run_id=run_id,
            assistant_message_id=assistant_message_id,
            content=content,
            usage=notes,
            first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            finished_at=now,
        )
        await publisher.emit(
            "message.done",
            {
                "conversation_id": str(conversation_id),
                "message_id": str(assistant_message_id),
                "usage": notes,
                "finish_reason": "stop",
                "model": model_name,
                "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
                "duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
                "citations": [],
                "artifacts": [],
                "reasoning": (
                    {
                        "duration_ms": int(
                            ((_now() - (reasoning_started or started_at)).total_seconds()) * 1000
                        ),
                        "tokens": notes["reasoning_tokens"],
                        "summary": "".join(reasoning_parts)[:2000],
                    }
                    if reasoning_parts
                    else None
                ),
            },
            event_type="message",
            title="助手回复",
            subtitle=content[:80],
            duration_ms=duration_ms,
            tokens=notes,
        )
    except asyncio.CancelledError:
        logger.info("运行被取消 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_canceled(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,
            )
        )
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 后台任务必须兜底，避免静默丢失
        logger.exception("运行失败 run_id=%s", run_id)
        await asyncio.shield(
            _finalize_failed(
                run_id=run_id,
                content="".join(content_parts),
                usage=_usage_dict(usage),
                first_token_ms=first_token_ms,
                started_at=started_at or started_wall,
                publisher=publisher,
                error=exc,
            )
        )


async def _finalize_success(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    assistant_message_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    duration_ms: int,
    finished_at: datetime,
) -> None:
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        assistant = await db.get(Message, assistant_message_id)
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "completed"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is not None:
            run.status = "succeeded"
            run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
            run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
            run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
            run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
            run.duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
            run.finished_at = finished_at
            conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
            if conversation is not None:
                conversation.last_message_at = finished_at
                conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80]
                conversation.message_count += 1
        await db.commit()


async def _finalize_canceled(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "canceled"
            assistant.usage = usage
        run.status = "canceled"
        run.canceled_at = now
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        run.input_tokens = usage["input_tokens"]
        run.output_tokens = usage["output_tokens"]
        run.reasoning_tokens = usage["reasoning_tokens"]
        conversation = await db.get(Conversation, run.conversation_id)
        if conversation is not None:
            conversation.last_message_at = now
            conversation.last_message_preview = content[:80] or "（已取消）"
        await db.commit()
        message_id = run.assistant_message_id
        model_name = run.model

    await publisher.emit(
        "message.done",
        {
            "message_id": str(message_id) if message_id else "",
            "usage": usage,
            "finish_reason": "canceled",
            "model": model_name,
            "first_token_ms": first_token_ms,
            "duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "active_duration_ms": duration_ms,
            "citations": [],
            "artifacts": [],
        },
        event_type="message",
        status="canceled",
        title="已取消",
        duration_ms=duration_ms,
        tokens=usage,
    )


async def _finalize_failed(
    *,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    content: str,
    usage: dict[str, int],
    first_token_ms: int | None,
    started_at: datetime,
    publisher: RunEventPublisher,
    error: Exception,
) -> None:
    now = _now()
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    message = "模型调用失败，请稍后重试"
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return
        assistant = (
            await db.get(Message, run.assistant_message_id)
            if run.assistant_message_id
            else None
        )
        if assistant is not None:
            assistant.content = content
            assistant.status = "failed"
            assistant.usage = usage
            assistant.error = {"code": "llm_error", "message": message, "retryable": True}
        run.status = "failed"
        run.error_code = "llm_error"
        run.error_message = message
        run.finished_at = now
        run.duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
        run.first_token_ms = first_token_ms
        await db.commit()

    await publisher.emit(
        "error",
        {
            "code": "llm_error",
            "message": message,
            "request_id": current_request_id(),
            "run_id": str(run_id),
            "retryable": True,
        },
        event_type="error",
        status="error",
        title="运行失败",
        error={"code": "llm_error", "message": message},
    )


async def get_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunOut:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = (
        int((run.finished_at - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
        if run.finished_at and started_at
        else int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    )
    usage = _usage_out(
        {
            "input_tokens": run.input_tokens,
            "output_tokens": run.output_tokens,
            "reasoning_tokens": run.reasoning_tokens,
            "total_tokens": run.input_tokens + run.output_tokens,
        }
    )
    pending = await db.scalar(
        select(Approval)
        .where(
            Approval.run_id == run.id,
            Approval.status == "pending",
            or_(Approval.expires_at.is_(None), Approval.expires_at > now),
        )
        .order_by(Approval.created_at.desc())
        .limit(1)
    )
    pending_out = RunPendingOut()
    if pending is not None:
        pending_out = RunPendingOut(kind="approval", approval_id=pending.id)
    error = (
        MessageErrorOut(code=run.error_code, message=run.error_message, retryable=True)
        if run.error_code
        else None
    )
    return RunOut(
        id=run.id,
        conversation_id=run.conversation_id,
        status=run.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        source=run.source,
        model=run.model or None,
        reasoning_effort=run.reasoning_effort,
        workflow=None,
        capabilities=_normalize_capabilities(run.capabilities),
        usage=usage,
        started_at=run.started_at,
        finished_at=run.finished_at,
        duration_ms=run.duration_ms or duration_ms,
        active_duration_ms=run.active_duration_ms or duration_ms,
        first_token_ms=run.first_token_ms,
        pending=pending_out,
        message_ids=RunMessageIdsOut(
            user=run.user_message_id, assistant=run.assistant_message_id
        ),
        agents=(
            [
                RunAgentOut(
                    kind="local",
                    id="main-agent",
                    name="main-agent",
                    model=run.model or None,
                    state="online" if run.status == "running" else "idle",
                )
            ]
            if run.model
            else []
        ),
        error=error,
    )


async def list_run_events(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    run_id: uuid.UUID,
    *,
    limit: int,
    after_seq: int | None,
    types: str | None,
    q: str | None,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> RunEventPage:
    await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    stmt = select(RunEvent).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id).order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
    if after_seq is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > after_seq)
    if cursor:
        from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor

        raw = decode_cursor(cursor).get("seq")
        if isinstance(raw, int):
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.seq > raw)
    if types:
        allowed = [item.strip() for item in types.split(",") if item.strip()]
        if allowed:
            stmt = stmt.where(RunEvent.type.in_(allowed))
    if q:
        pattern = f"%{q}%"
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(RunEvent.title.ilike(pattern), RunEvent.subtitle.ilike(pattern))
        )
    stmt = stmt.limit(limit + 1)
    rows = list((await db.execute(stmt)).scalars().all())
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items: list[RunEventOut] = []
    for row in rows:
        payload = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
        error_message = None
        if isinstance(row.error, dict):
            error_message = str(row.error.get("message") or "")
        items.append(
            RunEventOut(
                id=f"{run_id}:{row.seq}",
                seq=row.seq,
                ts=row.ts,
                type=row.type,
                status=row.status,
                title=row.title,
                subtitle=row.subtitle,
                duration_ms=row.duration_ms,
                tokens=row.tokens or None,
                payload=payload,
                error=error_message,
            )
        )
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"seq": rows[-1].seq})
    return RunEventPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more)


async def cancel_run(db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> RunCancelResult:
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status not in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
        raise RunNotCancelableError(run.status)
    now = _now()
    started_at = run.started_at or run.created_at
    duration_ms = int((now - started_at).total_seconds() * 1000)
    run.status = "canceled"
    run.canceled_at = now
    run.finished_at = now
    run.duration_ms = duration_ms
    run.active_duration_ms = duration_ms
    await db.execute(
        update(Message)
        .where(Message.run_id == run_id, Message.status == "streaming")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.execute(
        update(Approval)
        .where(Approval.run_id == run_id, Approval.status == "pending")
        .values(status="canceled")
    )
    await db.commit()
    registry.cancel(run_id)
    return RunCancelResult(id=run.id, status="canceled", canceled_at=now)


async def resume_run(
    db: AsyncSession, user: User, run_id: uuid.UUID, user_input: str
) -> RunResumeResult:
    del user_input
    run = await _load_owned_run(db, user, run_id)
    if run.status != "interrupted":
        raise ConflictError("当前运行不处于等待输入状态", code="run_not_resumable")
    # M1 还没有会触发 interrupt 的工具；保留端点形状，接入 A2A/MCP 后实现 Command(resume)。
    raise ConflictError("当前版本不支持恢复运行", code="run_not_resumable")


async def stream_run_events(
    run_id: uuid.UUID, *, after_seq: int = 0
) -> AsyncIterator[str]:
    """SSE 生成器：先回放已落库事件，再跟随实时事件。"""
    settings = get_settings()
    queue = await bus.subscribe(run_id)
    last_seq = after_seq
    try:
        async with get_session_factory()() as db:
            rows = list(
                (
                    await db.execute(
                        select(RunEvent)
                        .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id, RunEvent.seq > last_seq)
                        .order_by(RunEvent.seq.asc())
                    )
                )
                .scalars()
                .all()
            )
        for row in rows:
            if row.seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            event_name = str((row.payload or {}).get("_event") or "")
            if not event_name:
                continue
            data = {k: v for k, v in (row.payload or {}).items() if k != "_event"}
            last_seq = row.seq
            yield format_sse(row.seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return

        idle_seconds = 0
        heartbeat_seconds = 15
        while True:
            try:
                item = await asyncio.wait_for(queue.get(), timeout=heartbeat_seconds)
            except TimeoutError:
                idle_seconds += heartbeat_seconds
                if idle_seconds >= settings.hitl_stream_timeout_seconds:
                    logger.info("SSE 等待超时 run_id=%s", run_id)
                    return
                yield ": ping\n\n"
                continue
            idle_seconds = 0
            data = item.get("data", {})
            seq = int(data.get("seq") or 0)
            if seq <= last_seq:
                continue
            last_seq = seq
            event_name = str(item.get("event") or "")
            yield format_sse(seq, event_name, data)
            if event_name in TERMINAL_EVENTS:
                return
    finally:
        await bus.unsubscribe(run_id, queue)


async def has_run_events(db: AsyncSession, run_id: uuid.UUID) -> bool:
    count = await db.scalar(
        select(func.count(RunEvent.id)).where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)

    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        run = await db.get(Run, run_id)
        if run is None:
            return False
        if run.status in _ACTIVE_STATUSES:
            return False
        event = await db.scalar(
            select(RunEvent)
            .where(RunEvent.run_id == run_id)
            .order_by(RunEvent.seq.desc())
            .limit(1)
        )
        return bool(event)


def run_status_of(value: str) -> RunStatus:
    return value  # type: ignore[return-value]

{"file_path": "/home/zhaodan/work/PythonProjects/agent-hub/app/modules/approvals/service.py", "content": """"审批查询与决定。

M1 只有数据模型与接口；能触发 interrupt 的工具在 M2/M5 接入，
届时批准后通过 Command(resume=...) 继续同一条 run。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import (
    ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError,
    ApprovalExpiredError,
    NotFoundError,
)
from app.db.models.approval import Approval
from app.db.models.chat import Run
from app.db.models.conversation import Conversation
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.approvals.schemas import (
    ApprovalDeciderOut,
    ApprovalDecisionRequest,
    ApprovalDecisionResult,
    ApprovalOut,
    ApprovalPage,
)

_STATUSES = ("pending", "approved", "rejected", "expired", "canceled")


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _preview(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    try:
        raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return raw[:500]


def _approval_out(
    approval: Approval,
    conversation_title: str,
    decider: User | None,
) -> ApprovalOut:
    return ApprovalOut(
        id=approval.id,
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        conversation_id=approval.a2a_task_id or uuid.UUID(int=0),
        conversation_title=conversation_title,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        tool_name=approval.tool_name,
        tool_display_name=approval.tool_display_name,
        source=approval.source,
        executor=approval.executor,
        target=approval.target,
        side_effect=approval.side_effect,
        risk=approval.risk,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        reason=approval.reason,
        payload=approval.payload or {},
        payload_preview=approval.payload_preview,
        expires_at=approval.expires_at,
        created_at=approval.created_at,
        decided_at=approval.decided_at,
        decided_by=(
            ApprovalDeciderOut(id=decider.id, display_name=decider.display_name)
            if decider
            else None
        ),
        decision_note=approval.decision_note,
    )


def _base_query():
    return (
        select(Approval, Conversation.title, User)
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
        .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
        .outerjoin(User, Approval.decided_by == User.id)
    )


async def list_approvals(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    status: str,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    run_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> ApprovalPage:
    stmt = _base_query().where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
    if status in _STATUSES:
        stmt = stmt.where(Approval.status == status)
    if conversation_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    if run_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Approval.run_id == run_id)
    cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor_data:
        raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
        try:
            last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise NotFoundError("分页游标无效") from exc
        if last_time is None or last_id is None:
            raise NotFoundError("分页游标无效")
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(
                Approval.created_at < last_time,
                and_(Approval.created_at == last_time, Approval.id < last_id),
            )
        )
    stmt = stmt.order_by(Approval.created_at.desc(), Approval.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = (await db.execute(stmt)).all()
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items = [
        _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)
        for row in rows
    ]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1][0]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})

    stats_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Approval.status, func.count(Approval.id))
            .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
            .group_by(Approval.status)
        )
    ).all()
    stats = {key: 0 for key in _STATUSES}
    for key, count in stats_rows:
        if key in stats:
            stats[key] = int(count)
    return ApprovalPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more, stats=stats)


async def get_approval(db: AsyncSession, user: User, approval_id: uuid.UUID) -> ApprovalOut:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            _base_query().where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
        )
    ).first()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    return _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)


async def decide(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    approval_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: ApprovalDecisionRequest,
) -> ApprovalDecisionResult:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Approval, Conversation.title)
            .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
    ).first()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    approval: Approval = row[0]
    now = _now()
    if approval.status == "pending" and approval.expires_at and approval.expires_at <= now:
        approval.status = "expired"
        await db.commit()
        raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
    if approval.status != "pending":
        if approval.status == "expired":
            raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
        raise ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError("审批已处理，请刷新状态")

    approval.status = "approved" if payload.decision == "approve" else "rejected"
    approval.decided_by = user.id
    approval.decided_at = now
    approval.decision_note = payload.note
    run = await db.get(Run, approval.run_id)
    resumed = False
    resume_error: str | None = None
    if payload.decision == "approve":
        if run is not None and run.status == "interrupted":
            resume_error = "当前版本尚未接入可恢复工具，请在 M2 后重试"
        else:
            resume_error = "运行不处于等待审批状态"
    await db.commit()
    return ApprovalDecisionResult(
        id=approval.id,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        resumed=resumed,
        resume_error=resume_error,
    )


async def expire_pending(limit: int = 200) -> int:
    """后台巡检：把超时未处理的审批置为 expired。"""
    now = _now()
    async with __import__("app.db.session", fromlist=["get_session_factory"]).get_session_factory()() as db:
        ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Approval.id)
                    .where(
                        Approval.status == "pending",
                        Approval.expires_at.is_not(None),
                        Approval.expires_at <= now,
                    )
                    .limit(limit)
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        if not ids:
            return 0
        await db.execute(
            update(Approval).where(Approval.id.in_(ids)).values(status="expired")
        )
        await db.commit()
        return len(ids)
"}

M1 只有数据模型与接口；能触发 interrupt 的工具在 M2/M5 接入，
届时批准后通过 Command(resume=...) 继续同一条 run。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import uuid
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any

from sqlalchemy import and_, func, or_, select, update
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from app.core.cursor import decode_cursor, encode_cursor
from app.core.errors import (
    ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError,
    ApprovalExpiredError,
    NotFoundError,
)
from app.db.models.approval import Approval
from app.db.models.chat import Run
from app.db.models.conversation import Conversation
from app.db.models.user import User
from app.modules.approvals.schemas import (
    ApprovalDeciderOut,
    ApprovalDecisionRequest,
    ApprovalDecisionResult,
    ApprovalOut,
    ApprovalPage,
)

_STATUSES = ("pending", "approved", "rejected", "expired", "canceled")


def _now() -> datetime:
    return datetime.now(UTC)


def _preview(payload: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    try:
        raw = json.dumps(payload, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":"))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return raw[:500]


def _approval_out(
    approval: Approval,
    conversation_title: str,
    decider: User | None,
) -> ApprovalOut:
    return ApprovalOut(
        id=approval.id,
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        conversation_id=approval.a2a_task_id or uuid.UUID(int=0),
        conversation_title=conversation_title,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        tool_name=approval.tool_name,
        tool_display_name=approval.tool_display_name,
        source=approval.source,
        executor=approval.executor,
        target=approval.target,
        side_effect=approval.side_effect,
        risk=approval.risk,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        reason=approval.reason,
        payload=approval.payload or {},
        payload_preview=approval.payload_preview,
        expires_at=approval.expires_at,
        created_at=approval.created_at,
        decided_at=approval.decided_at,
        decided_by=(
            ApprovalDeciderOut(id=decider.id, display_name=decider.display_name)
            if decider
            else None
        ),
        decision_note=approval.decision_note,
    )


def _base_query():
    return (
        select(Approval, Conversation.title, User)
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
        .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
        .outerjoin(User, Approval.decided_by == User.id)
    )


async def list_approvals(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    *,
    status: str,
    conversation_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    run_id: uuid.UUID | None,
    limit: int,
    cursor: str | None,
) -> ApprovalPage:
    stmt = _base_query().where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
    if status in _STATUSES:
        stmt = stmt.where(Approval.status == status)
    if conversation_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Run.conversation_id == conversation_id)
    if run_id is not None:
        stmt = stmt.where(Approval.run_id == run_id)
    cursor_data = decode_cursor(cursor)
    if cursor_data:
        raw_time = cursor_data.get("t")
        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")
        try:
            last_time = datetime.fromisoformat(raw_time) if raw_time else None
            last_id = uuid.UUID(str(raw_id)) if raw_id else None
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as exc:
            raise NotFoundError("分页游标无效") from exc
        if last_time is None or last_id is None:
            raise NotFoundError("分页游标无效")
        stmt = stmt.where(
            or_(
                Approval.created_at < last_time,
                and_(Approval.created_at == last_time, Approval.id < last_id),
            )
        )
    stmt = stmt.order_by(Approval.created_at.desc(), Approval.id.desc()).limit(limit + 1)
    rows = (await db.execute(stmt)).all()
    has_more = len(rows) > limit
    rows = rows[:limit]
    items = [
        _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)
        for row in rows
    ]
    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:
        last = rows[-1][0]
        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})

    stats_rows = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Approval.status, func.count(Approval.id))
            .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)
            .group_by(Approval.status)
        )
    ).all()
    stats = {key: 0 for key in _STATUSES}
    for key, count in stats_rows:
        if key in stats:
            stats[key] = int(count)
    return ApprovalPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more, stats=stats)


async def get_approval(db: AsyncSession, user: User, approval_id: uuid.UUID) -> ApprovalOut:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            _base_query().where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
        )
    ).first()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    return _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)


async def decide(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    approval_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: ApprovalDecisionRequest,
) -> ApprovalDecisionResult:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Approval, Conversation.title)
            .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
    ).first()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    approval: Approval = row[0]
    now = _now()
    if approval.status == "pending" and approval.expires_at and approval.expires_at <= now:
        approval.status = "expired"
        await db.commit()
        raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
    if approval.status != "pending":
        if approval.status == "expired":
            raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
        raise ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError("审批已处理，请刷新状态")

    approval.status = "approved" if payload.decision == "approve" else "rejected"
    approval.decided_by = user.id
    approval.decided_at = now
    approval.decision_note = payload.note
    run = await db.get(Run, approval.run_id)
    resumed = False
    resume_error: str | None = None
    if payload.decision == "approve":
        if run is not None and run.status == "interrupted":
            resume_error = "当前版本尚未接入可恢复工具，请在 M2 后重试"
        else:
            resume_error = "运行不处于等待审批状态"
    await db.commit()
    return ApprovalDecisionResult(
        id=approval.id,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        resumed=resumed,
        resume_error=resume_error,
    )


async def expire_pending(limit: int = 200) -> int:
    """后台巡检：把超时未处理的审批置为 expired。"""
    now = _now()
    async with __import__("app.db.session", fromlist=["get_session_factory"]).get_session_factory()() as db:
        ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Approval.id)
                    .where(
                        Approval.status == "pending",
                        Approval.expires_at.is_not(None),
                        Approval.expires_at <= now,
                    )
                    .limit(limit)
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        if not ids:
            return 0
        await db.execute(
            update(Approval).where(Approval.id.in_(ids)).values(status="expired")
        )
        await db.commit()
        return len(ids)
"}

from app import __version__
from app.core.config import Settings, get_settings

    EmbeddingInfoOut,
    GenerationInfoOut,
    ModelCapabilitiesOut,
    ModelInfoOut,
    ReasoningEffortOptionOut,
    SystemA2aInfoOut,
    SystemCapabilitiesOut,
    SystemInfoOut,
    SystemLimitsOut,
)

_REASONING_EFFORTS = [
    ReasoningEffortOptionOut(id="low", name="标准", description="更快，适合日常"),
    ReasoningEffortOptionOut(id="medium", name="深度", description="平衡速度与推理"),
    ReasoningEffortOptionOut(id="high", name="最大", description="更深入，耗时更长"),
]


def build_system_info(settings: Settings | None = None) -> SystemInfoOut:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    models = [
        ModelInfoOut(
            id=model,
            name=model,
            description="" if model != settings.llm_model else "默认对话模型",
            capabilities=ModelCapabilitiesOut(
                streaming=True,
                reasoning=settings.llm_reasoning_effort_supported,
                tools=True,
            ),
        )
        for model in settings.allowed_models
    ]
    base_url = settings.a2a_public_url.rstrip("/")
    agent_path = "/" + settings.a2a_agent_path.strip("/")
    return SystemInfoOut(
        version=__version__,
        build=settings.build_label,
        environment=settings.env,
        models=models,
        default_model=settings.llm_model,

            _REASONING_EFFORTS if settings.llm_reasoning_effort_supported else []

            attachments_per_message=settings.attachments_per_message,
            attachment_max_bytes=settings.attachment_max_bytes,
            message_max_chars=settings.message_max_chars,
        ),
    )
"}

from __future__ import annotations

import logging

from fastapi import APIRouter
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from sqlalchemy import text

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db.session import get_engine

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

router = APIRouter(tags=["系统"])


@router.get("/healthz")
async def healthz() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {"status": "ok", "app": get_settings().app_name}


@router.get("/readyz")
async def readyz() -> JSONResponse:
    components: list[dict[str, object]] = []
    try:
        async with get_engine().connect() as conn:
            await conn.execute(text("SELECT 1"))
        components.append({"name": "database", "status": "ok"})
        status_code = 200
        overall = "ok"
    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 - 探针需要把异常转成状态
        logger.warning("数据库就绪检查失败：%s", exc)
        components.append({"name": "database", "status": "error"})
        status_code = 503
        overall = "error"
    return JSONResponse(
        status_code=status_code,
        content={"status": overall, "components": components},
    )
"}

    ApprovalPage,

    return datetime.now(UTC)

    try:

    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return ""
    return raw[:500]

    approval: Approval,
    conversation: Conversation,
    decider: User | None,
) -> ApprovalOut:
    return ApprovalOut(
        id=approval.id,
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        conversation_id=conversation.id,
        conversation_title=conversation.title,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        tool_name=approval.tool_name,
        tool_display_name=approval.tool_display_name,
        source=approval.source,
        executor=approval.executor,
        target=approval.target,
        side_effect=approval.side_effect,
        risk=approval.risk,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        reason=approval.reason,
        payload=approval.payload or {},
        payload_preview=approval.payload_preview,
        expires_at=approval.expires_at,
        created_at=approval.created_at,
        decided_at=approval.decided_at,
        decided_by=(
            ApprovalDeciderOut(id=decider.id, display_name=decider.display_name)
            if decider
            else None
        ),
        decision_note=approval.decision_note,

def _base_query():

        select(Approval, Conversation, User)
        .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)

    db: AsyncSession,

        raw_id = cursor_data.get("id")

            )

    items = [
        _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)
        for row in rows

    next_cursor = None
    if has_more and rows:

        next_cursor = encode_cursor({"t": last.created_at.isoformat(), "id": last.id})

        await db.execute(

            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Conversation.user_id == user.id)

        await db.execute(
            update(Approval).where(Approval.id.in_(ids)).values(status="expired")
        )
        await db.commit()
        return len(ids)

    return ApprovalPage(items=items, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=has_more, stats=stats)


async def get_approval(db: AsyncSession, user: User, approval_id: uuid.UUID) -> ApprovalOut:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            _base_query().where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
        )
    ).first()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    return _approval_out(row[0], row[1], row[2] if isinstance(row[2], User) else None)


async def decide(
    db: AsyncSession,
    user: User,
    approval_id: uuid.UUID,
    payload: ApprovalDecisionRequest,
) -> ApprovalDecisionResult:
    row = (
        await db.execute(
            select(Approval)
            .join(Run, Approval.run_id == Run.id)
            .join(Conversation, Run.conversation_id == Conversation.id)
            .where(Approval.id == approval_id, Conversation.user_id == user.id)
            .with_for_update()
        )
    ).scalar_one_or_none()
    if row is None:
        raise NotFoundError("审批不存在")
    approval = row
    now = _now()
    if approval.status == "pending" and approval.expires_at and approval.expires_at <= now:
        approval.status = "expired"
        await db.commit()
        raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
    if approval.status != "pending":
        if approval.status == "expired":
            raise ApprovalExpiredError("审批已过期")
        raise ApprovalAlreadyDecidedError("审批已处理，请刷新状态")

    approval.status = "approved" if payload.decision == "approve" else "rejected"
    approval.decided_by = user.id
    approval.decided_at = now
    approval.decision_note = payload.note
    run = await db.get(Run, approval.run_id)
    resumed = False
    resume_error: str | None = None
    if payload.decision == "approve":
        if run is not None and run.status == "interrupted":
            resume_error = "当前版本尚未接入可恢复工具，请在 M2 后重试"
        else:
            resume_error = "运行不处于等待审批状态"
    await db.commit()
    return ApprovalDecisionResult(
        id=approval.id,
        status=approval.status,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        run_id=approval.run_id,
        resumed=resumed,
        resume_error=resume_error,
    )


async def expire_pending(limit: int = 200) -> int:
    """后台巡检：把超时未处理的审批置为 expired。"""
    now = _now()
    async with get_session_factory()() as db:
        ids = list(
            (
                await db.execute(
                    select(Approval.id)
                    .where(
                        Approval.status == "pending",
                        Approval.expires_at.is_not(None),
                        Approval.expires_at <= now,
                    )
                    .limit(limit)
                )
            ).scalars()
        )
        if not ids:
            return 0
        await db.execute(
            update(Approval).where(Approval.id.in_(ids)).values(status="expired")
        )
        await db.commit()
        return len(ids)
"}

async def _approval_sweeper() -> None:
    while True:
        await asyncio.sleep(60)
        try:
            expired = await expire_pending()
            if expired:
                logger.info("审批超时巡检：%s 条置为 expired", expired)
        except asyncio.CancelledError:
            raise
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - 后台巡检失败不能拖垮服务

@asynccontextmanager
async def lifespan(app: FastAPI) -> AsyncIterator[None]:

    sweeper = asyncio.create_task(_approval_sweeper(), name="approval-sweeper")
    logger.info("agent-hub 启动完成 env=%s", settings.env)
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        sweeper.cancel()
        await asyncio.gather(sweeper, return_exceptions=True)
        await registry.shutdown()

        logger.info("agent-hub 已停止")

    register_exception_handlers(app)
    app.include_router(health_router)
    app.include_router(api_router, prefix=settings.api_prefix)
    return app


app = create_app()

所有模型通过 ``app.db.models`` 汇总导入，保证 autogenerate 可见。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
from logging.config import fileConfig

from alembic import context
from sqlalchemy import pool
from sqlalchemy.engine import Connection
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import async_engine_from_config

from app.core.config import get_settings
from app.db.base import Base
from app.db import models  # noqa: F401  # 导入以注册全部模型

config = context.config
if config.config_file_name is not None:
    fileConfig(config.config_file_name)

config.set_main_option("sqlalchemy.url", get_settings().database_url)
target_metadata = Base.metadata


def run_migrations_offline() -> None:
    context.configure(
        url=config.get_main_option("sqlalchemy.url"),
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        literal_binds=True,
        dialect_opts={"paramstyle": "named"},
        compare_type=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


def do_run_migrations(connection: Connection) -> None:
    context.configure(
        connection=connection,
        target_metadata=target_metadata,
        compare_type=True,
        compare_server_default=True,
    )
    with context.begin_transaction():
        context.run_migrations()


async def run_async_migrations() -> None:
    connectable = async_engine_from_config(
        config.get_section(config.config_ini_section, {}),
        prefix="sqlalchemy.",
        poolclass=pool.NullPool,
    )
    async with connectable.connect() as connection:
        await connection.run_sync(do_run_migrations)
    await connectable.dispose()


def run_migrations_online() -> None:
    asyncio.run(run_async_migrations())


if context.is_offline_mode():
    run_migrations_offline()
else:
    run_migrations_online()
"}

**Important bug**: `cancel_run` updates assistant message status to canceled, then `_finalize_canceled` sets content/usage and status; good.

**Important bug**: `execute_run` uses `started_at` from run; if run.started_at naive? Postgres timestamptz returns aware. fine.

**Potential issue**: LangGraph `MessagesState` requires `messages` reducer; input `{"messages": [HumanMessage]}` with checkpointer. Good.

**Potential issue**: `SystemMessage` plus `state["messages"]`; state messages from previous turns. Good.

**Issue**: `_find_active_run` after IntegrityError uses conversation.id; after rollback, `conversation` may be expired but id is PK loaded; fine.

async def collect_stream(client, headers, payload, stop_on=("message.done","error")):
    events=[]
    async with client.stream(...) as resp:
        assert resp.status_code==200
        run_id=resp.headers.get("x-run-id")
        event=None
        async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
            if line.startswith("event:"): event=line[6:].strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:"):
                data=json.loads(line[5:].strip())
                events.append((event,data))

    *,

    payload: dict,
    wanted: str,
    timeout: float = 10.0,
) -> tuple[str | None, list[tuple[str, dict]], httpx.Response | None]:
    """打开 SSE 直到出现指定事件；返回已读事件与打开的连接（用于取消场景）。"""
    events: list[tuple[str, dict]] = []
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async with client.stream(
            "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json=payload, headers=headers
        ) as response:
            run_id = response.headers.get("X-Run-ID")
            event_name: str | None = None
            async for line in response.aiter_lines():
                if line.startswith("event:"):
                    event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                    events.append((event_name, json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1].strip())))
                    if event_name == wanted:
                        return run_id, events, response
    return run_id, events, None

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

async def test_register_login_me_and_duplicate(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:

    assert payload["token_type"] == "bearer"
    assert payload["expires_in"] == 900

            "password": "password123",
            "display_name": "重复",
        },

    assert me.status_code == 200
    assert me.json()["role"] == "user"

    login = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"email": "alice@example.com", "password": "password123"},
    )
    assert login.status_code == 200
    assert login.json()["access_token"]

    wrong = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/login",
        json={"email": "alice@example.com", "password": "wrong-password"},
    )
    assert wrong.status_code == 401
    assert wrong.json()["error"]["code"] == "unauthorized"

    registered = await register_user(client)
    old_refresh = registered["refresh_token"]

    assert rotated.status_code == 200
    new_refresh = rotated.json()["refresh_token"]
    assert new_refresh != old_refresh

    replay = await client.post("/api/v1/auth/refresh", json={"refresh_token": old_refresh})
    assert replay.status_code == 401

    logout = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/logout",
        json={"refresh_token": new_refresh},
        headers=auth_headers(registered["access_token"]),
    )
    assert logout.status_code == 204

    after_logout = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/auth/refresh", json={"refresh_token": new_refresh}
    )
    assert after_logout.status_code == 401

    registered = await register_user(client, password="password123")
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    updated = await client.patch(
        "/api/v1/auth/me", json={"display_name": "老赵"}, headers=headers
    )
    assert updated.status_code == 200
    assert updated.json()["display_name"] == "老赵"

    )

    )

from __future__ import annotations

import httpx

from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user


async def test_conversation_crud_and_list_stats(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    created = await client.post("/api/v1/conversations", json={"title": "需求评审"}, headers=headers)
    assert created.status_code == 201
    conversation = created.json()
    assert conversation["message_count"] == 0
    assert conversation["status"] == "active"

    listed = await client.get("/api/v1/conversations?status=active&limit=10", headers=headers)
    assert listed.status_code == 200
    page = listed.json()
    assert page["stats"]["total"] == 1
    assert page["items"][0]["id"] == conversation["id"]

    search = await client.get("/api/v1/conversations?q=评审", headers=headers)
    assert search.json()["items"]
    empty_search = await client.get("/api/v1/conversations?q=不存在", headers=headers)
    assert empty_search.json()["items"] == []

    patched = await client.patch(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation['id']}",
        json={"title": "需求评审（归档）", "status": "archived"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert patched.status_code == 200
    assert patched.json()["status"] == "archived"

    detail = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation['id']}", headers=headers
    )
    assert detail.status_code == 200
    assert detail.json()["archived_at"] is not None
    assert detail.json()["last_run"] is None

    deleted = await client.delete(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation['id']}", headers=headers
    )
    assert deleted.status_code == 204
    missing = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation['id']}", headers=headers
    )
    assert missing.status_code == 404


async def test_messages_history_and_counts(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client, headers=headers, payload={"message": "帮我写一段项目介绍"}
    )
    assert run_id
    conversation_id = events[0][1]["conversation_id"]

    messages = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", headers=headers
    )
    assert messages.status_code == 200
    items = messages.json()["items"]
    assert [item["role"] for item in items] == ["assistant", "user"]
    assistant = items[0]
    assert assistant["status"] == "completed"
    assert assistant["usage"]["total_tokens"] > 0
    assert assistant["capabilities"]["skills"] == []
    assert assistant["citations"] == []

    listed = await client.get("/api/v1/conversations", headers=headers)
    item = listed.json()["items"][0]
    assert item["message_count"] == 2
    assert item["last_message_preview"]

    # 非所有者访问返回 404，不泄露资源是否存在
    other = await register_user(client)
    forbidden = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}", headers=auth_headers(other["access_token"])
    )
    assert forbidden.status_code == 404
"}

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import json

import httpx

from tests.conftest import auth_headers, collect_sse, register_user


async def test_stream_event_sequence(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    run_id, events = await collect_sse(
        client, headers=headers, payload={"message": "你好，介绍一下你自己"}
    )
    assert run_id
    names = [name for name, _ in events]
    assert names[0] == "conversation.created"
    assert names[1] == "run.started"
    assert names[2] == "message.created"
    assert names[3] == "message.started"
    assert "message.delta" in names
    assert names[-1] == "message.done"

    seqs = [data["seq"] for _, data in events]
    assert seqs == sorted(seqs)
    run_started = events[1][1]
    assert run_started["run_id"] == run_id
    assert run_started["conversation_id"]
    assert run_started["user_message_id"]

    done = events[-1][1]
    assert done["finish_reason"] == "stop"
    assert done["usage"]["total_tokens"] >= done["usage"]["output_tokens"] >= 1
    assert done["first_token_ms"] is not None
    assert done["duration_ms"] >= 0

    run = await client.get(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}", headers=headers)
    assert run.status_code == 200
    body = run.json()
    assert body["status"] == "succeeded"
    assert body["message_ids"]["user"]
    assert body["message_ids"]["assistant"]
    assert body["usage"]["total_tokens"] > 0

    events_api = await client.get(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/events", headers=headers)
    assert events_api.status_code == 200
    page = events_api.json()
    assert page["items"]
    assert page["items"][0]["seq"] == 1
    assert page["items"][0]["id"] == f"{run_id}:1"
    assert {item["type"] for item in page["items"]} >= {"request", "message"}

    only_request = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/events?types=request", headers=headers
    )
    assert all(item["type"] == "request" for item in only_request.json()["items"])


async def test_idempotent_replay(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])
    payload = {"message": "重复发送测试", "client_message_id": "c-001"}

    first_run_id, events = await collect_sse(client, headers=headers, payload=payload)
    conversation_id = events[0][1]["conversation_id"]

    second_run_id, replay_events = await collect_sse(
        client,
        headers=headers,
        payload={**payload, "conversation_id": conversation_id},
    )
    assert second_run_id == first_run_id
    assert replay_events[0][0] == "conversation.created"
    assert replay_events[-1][0] == "message.done"

    messages = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{conversation_id}/messages", headers=headers
    )
    assert len(messages.json()["items"]) == 2


async def test_concurrent_run_returns_409(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, second_client: httpx.AsyncClient
) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    async with client.stream(
        "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "第一条长消息"}, headers=headers
    ) as response:
        assert response.status_code == 200
        run_id = response.headers["X-Run-ID"]
        conversation_id = None
        event_name = None
        async for line in response.aiter_lines():
            if line.startswith("event:"):
                event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name == "run.started":
                conversation_id = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1])["conversation_id"]
                break
        assert conversation_id

        conflict = await second_client.post(
            "/api/v1/chat/stream",
            json={"conversation_id": conversation_id, "message": "第二条消息"},
            headers=headers,
        )
        assert conflict.status_code == 409
        error = conflict.json()["error"]
        assert error["code"] == "run_in_progress"
        assert error["details"]["run_id"] == run_id

        await second_client.post(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel", headers=headers)


async def test_cancel_preserves_partial_content(
    client: httpx.AsyncClient, second_client: httpx.AsyncClient
) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    done_event = None
    partial_text = ""
    async with client.stream(
        "POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "取消测试"}, headers=headers
    ) as response:
        run_id = response.headers["X-Run-ID"]
        event_name = None
        for _ in range(1):
            pass
        async for line in response.aiter_lines():
            if line.startswith("event:"):
                event_name = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
            elif line.startswith("data:") and event_name:
                data = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1])
                if event_name == "message.delta":
                    partial_text += data["delta"]
                    canceled = await second_client.post(
                        f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel", headers=headers
                    )
                    assert canceled.status_code == 200
                    assert canceled.json()["status"] == "canceled"
                if event_name == "message.done":
                    done_event = data
                    break

    assert done_event is not None
    assert done_event["finish_reason"] == "canceled"
    assert partial_text

    run = await client.get(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}", headers=headers)
    assert run.json()["status"] == "canceled"

    messages = await client.get(
        f"/api/v1/conversations/{done_event['conversation_id']}/messages",  # type: ignore[index]
        headers=headers,
    )
    assistant = next(item for item in messages.json()["items"] if item["role"] == "assistant")
    assert assistant["status"] == "canceled"
    assert assistant["content"] == partial_text

    again = await client.post(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel", headers=headers)
    assert again.status_code == 409
    assert again.json()["error"]["code"] == "run_not_cancelable"


async def test_validation_and_capability_errors(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    model_error = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/chat/stream",
        json={"message": "hi", "model": "not-allowed"},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert model_error.status_code == 422
    assert model_error.json()["error"]["code"] == "model_not_allowed"

    capability_error = await client.post(
        "/api/v1/chat/stream",
        json={"message": "hi", "skills": ["00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000"]},
        headers=headers,
    )
    assert capability_error.status_code == 403
    assert capability_error.json()["error"]["code"] == "capability_disabled"

    empty = await client.post("/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "  "}, headers=headers)
    assert empty.status_code == 422
    assert empty.json()["error"]["code"] == "validation_error"


async def test_system_info_and_readyz(client: httpx.AsyncClient) -> None:
    registered = await register_user(client)
    headers = auth_headers(registered["access_token"])

    info = await client.get("/api/v1/system/info", headers=headers)
    assert info.status_code == 200
    body = info.json()
    assert body["default_model"]
    assert body["models"][0]["capabilities"]["streaming"] is True
    assert body["capabilities"]["approvals"] is True
    assert body["capabilities"]["skills"] is False
    assert body["limits"]["message_max_chars"] == 8000
    assert body["a2a"]["card_url"].endswith("/a2a/.well-known/agent-card.json")

    health = await client.get("/healthz")
    assert health.status_code == 200
    ready = await client.get("/readyz")
    assert ready.status_code == 200
    assert ready.json()["status"] == "ok"

    await asyncio.sleep(0)
"}

- `types=request` filters.

        r = await c.post("/api/v1/auth/register", json={"email": email, "password": "password123", "display_name": "TCP"})

        t0 = time.time()
        first_delta = None
        done = None
        async with c.stream("POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "真实 TCP 流式验证"}, headers=h) as resp:
            print("status", resp.status_code, "headers_at", round(time.time()-t0, 3), "run_id", resp.headers.get("x-run-id"))
            ev = None
            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                if line.startswith("event:"):
                    ev = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif line.startswith("data:") and ev:
                    d = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1])
                    if ev == "message.delta" and first_delta is None:
                        first_delta = (round(time.time()-t0, 3), d["seq"])
                    if ev == "message.done":
                        done = (round(time.time()-t0, 3), d)

        canceled_done = None
        async with c.stream("POST", "/api/v1/chat/stream", json={"message": "取消 TCP 验证"}, headers=h) as resp:
            run_id = resp.headers["x-run-id"]
            ev = None
            async for line in resp.aiter_lines():
                if line.startswith("event:"):
                    ev = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
                elif line.startswith("data:") and ev:
                    d = json.loads(line.split(":", 1)[1])
                    if ev == "message.delta":
                        cr = await c2.post(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}/cancel", headers=h)
                        print("cancel", cr.status_code, cr.json().get("status"), "at", round(time.time()-t1,3))
                    if ev == "message.done":
                        canceled_done = d
                        break
        print("cancel_done", canceled_done["finish_reason"], "at", round(time.time()-t1,3))
        run = await c.get(f"/api/v1/runs/{run_id}", headers=h)
        msgs = await c.get(f"/api/v1/conversations/{canceled_done['conversation_id']}/messages", headers=h)

        print("run_status", run.json()["status"], "msg_status", assistant["status"], "partial_len", len(assistant["content"]))

asyncio.run(main())
